scope: Real Chromium UI with explicit metadata/knowledge API fixtures; no database or model requests
checks: opening never scans or approves automatically; no snapshot prevents a knowledge write
complete table and column pages, ordered constraints, runtime overrides and escaped database comments
conflict response retains manual input; successful save is pending and business text is escaped
acceptance requires an explicit reason and retains canceled review draft
manual and Agent content conflict is shown; merging is an explicit final user decision and preserves drafts
stale accepted knowledge requires explicit reconfirmation against current snapshot
unsaved text survives closing and stays isolated to its source
Agent launcher preserves existing input and prepares source-specific draft without submitting
explicit preparation click collects missing or stale structure; scan failure neither fills nor sends task
catalog revision drift is rejected, desktop dialog fits both sizes and dark theme
